questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 7 say a good name is better than?
Why does Ecclesiastes 7 say sorrow is better than laughter?
options: Because laughter is a sin that God will judge
Because by sadness of face the heart is made glad
Because mourning earns a man the praise of others
Because the wise have no need of joy or feasting
questions.answer: Because by sadness of face the heart is made glad
